headline: GIFT Nifty Signals Positive Start as Indian Markets Look to Rebound After Muhurat Trading Dip

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: GIFT Nifty trends indicate a positive opening for Sensex and Nifty 50.
Crude oil prices fell below $98 as geopolitical tensions regarding Iran eased.
Asian markets rebounded, providing favorable global cues for domestic equities.
Markets are seeking recovery after ending the Diwali Muhurat trading session in the red.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty snapped a seven-day winning streak during the Diwali Muhurat trading session.
GIFT Nifty traded higher, pointing to a positive opening for Indian benchmarks.
Key market drivers today include US Nonfarm Payrolls data and movement in crude oil prices.
Technical indicators show multiple stocks breaking above their 200-day moving averages.
summary: Indian equities are set for a positive start today on favorable GIFT Nifty signals and rebounding Asian markets. This follows a dip during the Diwali Muhurat trading session which snapped a seven-day rally. Lower crude oil prices and key global economic factors will guide today's trading action.
